context.transcript:
Hello, I saw your ad on television and I'd like to order 200 business cards.
Could I have my company's logo printed on them?
Of course.
All you have to do is send me an electronic copy of your company logo and we can take care of that for you.
By the way, right now we're having a special on business cards.
Orders of 500 or more are 10% off.
Honestly, I've just started my business.
Okay, we'll make it 200 then.
Be sure to send your logo and I'll work on a sample business card for you.
I should be able to do it this afternoon.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我在电视上看到了您的广告，我想订购 200 张名片。
可以在上面印上我公司的标志吗？
当然可以。
您只需要把公司标志的电子版发给我，我们就能帮您处理了。
顺便说一下，我们现在名片有特别优惠。
订单达到 500 张或以上可享受九折优惠。
老实说，我刚开始我的生意。
好的，那我们就做 200 张吧。
请务必把您的标志发给我，我会为您制作一张样品名片。
我今天下午应该能完成。
